units.en: Chongjin first served Lan Prefect Tang Qun as a company commander. After the Ancestor of Offerings executed Qun, he entered the Martial Emperor's service.
units.literal: Chongjin at first served Prefect Tang Qun of Lan as a company commander; the Ancestor of Offerings executed Qun, and thereafter he served the Martial Emperor.

units.zh: 莊宗初嗣位，入為步軍右都檢校司空，師出井陘，授行營馬軍都虞候，破汴軍於相鄉，論功授邠州刺史，轉檢校司徒。
units.en: When Zhuangzong first took the throne, Cunjin entered court as right commander of infantry and acting Minister of Works. On the Jingxing campaign he was made chief adjutant of the field cavalry, routed the Bian army at Xiangxiang, and was rewarded with Bin Prefecture, then promoted acting Grand Mentor.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong first succeeded to the throne, he entered the capital as right commander of foot soldiers and acting Minister of Works; when the army marched out through Jingxing Pass he was appointed chief adjutant of the campaign horse army; he defeated the Bian army at Xiangxiang; by merit he was appointed prefect of Bin and transferred to acting Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 《歐陽史》：太祖破朔州得之，賜以姓名，養為子。
units.en: The 《Ouyang History》 records that the Ancestor took him when Shuozhou fell, gave him the Li surname and name Cunjin, and raised him as an adopted son.
units.literal: 《Ouyang History》: The Ancestor obtained him when he captured Shuozhou, bestowed surname and personal name, and raised him as a son.

units.zh: 從入關，還鎮太原，署牙職。
units.en: He followed the army through the passes, returned to garrison Taiyuan, and was posted to the guard staff.
units.literal: He followed in entering the passes, returned to garrison Taiyuan, and was appointed to the guard staff.

units.zh: 景福中，為義兒軍使，賜姓名。
units.en: During the Jingfu era he became commander of the adopted-sons corps and received the Li surname and name Cunjin.
units.literal: In the Jingfu era he became commissioner of the adopted-sons army and was granted surname and personal name.

units.zh: 從討王行瑜，以功授檢校常侍，與李嗣昭同破王珙於河中。
units.en: He campaigned against Wang Xingyu and was made acting Palace Attendant for his service. With Li Sizhao he defeated Wang Gong at Hezhong.
units.literal: He followed in attacking Wang Xingyu and by merit was made acting Palace Attendant; with Li Sizhao he together defeated Wang Gong at Hezhong.

units.zh: 光化三年，契丹犯塞，寇雲中，改永安軍使、雁門以北都知兵馬使。
units.en: In the third year of Guanghua, when the Khitan raided the frontier and struck Yunzhong, he was made commissioner of the Yong'an army and overall commander of forces north of Yanmen Pass.
units.literal: In the third year of Guanghua the Khitan violated the frontier and raided Yunzhong; he was changed to commissioner of Yong'an army and overall commander of military affairs north of Yanmen.

units.zh: 天復初，破氏叔琮前軍於洞渦。
units.en: Early in the Tianfu era he routed Shi Shuzong's vanguard at Dongwo.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he defeated Shi Shuzong's vanguard at Dongwo.

units.zh: 三年，授石州刺史。
units.en: In the third year he was appointed prefect of Shi.
units.literal: In the third year he was appointed prefect of Shi.

units.zh: 十二年，定魏博，授天雄軍都巡按使。
units.en: In the twelfth year, after Weibo was pacified, he was made overall inspector of the Tianxiong army.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he pacified Weibo and was appointed overall inspector of the Tianxiong army.

units.zh: 十四年，擢蕃漢馬步副總管，從攻楊劉，戰胡柳。
units.en: In the fourteenth year he was promoted deputy overall commander of barbarian and Han forces, joined the assault on Yangliu, and fought at Huliu.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to deputy overall commander of barbarian and Han horse and foot; he followed in attacking Yangliu and fought at Huliu.

units.zh: 十六年，以本職兼領振武節度使。
units.en: In the sixteenth year he retained his post while also taking the Zhenwu military commission.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, while retaining his present post, he also held the military commission of Zhenwu.

units.zh: 十九年，汴將王瓚率眾逼北城，為地穴火車，百道進攻。
units.en: In the nineteenth year the Liang general Wang Zan pressed the north wall with tunnel mines and fire carts, assaulting along a hundred avenues at once.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year the Bian general Wang Zan led his masses to press the north wall, employing tunnel mines and fire carts, attacking along a hundred routes.

units.zh: 七月，存進代嗣昭為招討，進營東垣渡，夾滹□為壘，沙土散惡，垣壁難成。
units.en: In the seventh month Cunjin replaced Sizhao as suppression commissioner and encamped at Dongyuan Ford, building ramparts along the Hutuo. The sand and soil were loose and treacherous, and the walls would not hold.
units.literal: In the seventh month Cunjin replaced Sizhao as suppression commissioner, advanced to encamp at Dongyuan Ford, and built ramparts flanking the Hutuo, but the sand and soil were loose and foul and walls were hard to complete.

units.zh: 九月，王處球盡率其眾，乘其無備，奄至壘門。
units.en: In the ninth month Wang Chuqiu marched out with his full strength, caught them unprepared, and burst upon the rampart gate.
units.literal: In the ninth month Wang Chuqiu led out all his forces, taking advantage of their unreadiness, and suddenly reached the rampart gate.

units.zh: 俄而賊大至，後軍不繼，血戰而歿，時年六十六。
units.en: But the enemy soon swarmed up in force, his reinforcements failed to arrive, and he fell in a bloody last stand at the age of sixty-six.
units.literal: Soon the rebels arrived in force; the rear army did not follow up, and he fell in bloody battle, aged sixty-six.

units.zh: 同光時，贈太尉。
units.en: In the Tongguang era he was posthumously honored as Grand Commandant.
units.literal: In the Tongguang era he was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 父牷，世吏單于府。
units.en: His father Quan had for generations served as a clerk in the Chanyu Court.
units.literal: His father Quan for generations served as clerk in the Chanyu Court.

units.zh: 有子四人，長曰漢韶。
units.en: He had four sons; the eldest was Hanshao.
units.literal: He had four sons; the eldest was called Hanshao.

units.zh: 俄兼西南面行營招討使，出師收慈州，授慈、沁二州刺史。
units.en: He was soon made commissioner for the southwestern suppression campaign, marched out to recover Ci Prefecture, and was given Ci and Qin prefectures.
units.literal: Soon he was also made southwest campaign suppression commissioner; he led out the army to recover Ci Prefecture and was appointed prefect of Ci and Qin.

units.zh: 賜寶馬御衣，進檢校太保，兼魏博馬步都將。
units.en: He received an imperial horse and robes, was promoted acting Grand Guardian, and was made overall commander of Weibo horse and foot.
units.literal: He was bestowed a treasured horse and imperial robes, promoted to acting Grand Guardian, and also made overall commander of Weibo horse and foot.

units.zh: 汴軍退，加檢校太傅。
units.en: After the Liang army withdrew he was promoted acting Grand Tutor.
units.literal: When the Bian army withdrew he was further made acting Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 王師以船渡，緩急難濟，存進率意欲造浮橋。
units.en: The imperial forces relied on boats, which could not keep pace in a crisis. Cunjin resolved to build a pontoon bridge of his own.
units.literal: The royal army crossed by boat, which in urgency or delay was hard to sustain; Cunjin on his own initiative wished to build a pontoon bridge.

units.zh: 乃課軍造葦笮，維大艦數十艘，作土山，植巨木於岸以纜之。
units.en: He set the troops to weaving reed rafts, lashed dozens of large vessels together, raised earthen mounds, and drove great timbers into the banks to anchor the cables.
units.literal: He then set the army to making reed rafts, moored several dozen large ships, built earthen mounds, and planted huge timbers on the banks to cable them.

units.zh: 初，軍中以為戲，月餘橋成，制度條直，人皆服其勤智。
units.en: At first the troops treated the project as a joke. A little over a month later the bridge stood complete, trim and true, and all marveled at his ingenuity and persistence.
units.literal: At first the army regarded it as a jest; in a little over a month the bridge was complete, its structure orderly and straight, and all submitted to his diligence and wisdom.

units.zh: 與李存審固守德勝。
units.en: He and Li Cunshen held Desheng in a stubborn defense.
units.literal: With Li Cunshen he staunchly defended Desheng.

units.zh: 存進隨機拒應，或經日不得食。
units.en: Cunjin met each threat as it came, sometimes going a full day without a meal.
units.literal: Cunjin responded as circumstances required, sometimes going a full day without food.

units.zh: 存進聞之，得部下數人出鬥，驅賊於橋下。
units.en: Hearing the alarm, Cunjin took a handful of men and sallied forth, driving the enemy back below the bridge.
units.literal: When Cunjin heard of it he took a few subordinates and went out to fight, driving the rebels below the bridge.

units.zh: 存進曰：「吾成算在心，必有所立。」
units.en: Cunjin replied, "I already have the plan in mind. It will be done."
units.literal: Cunjin said, "I have the completed plan in my heart and shall certainly establish something."

units.zh: 存進行軍出師，雖無奇跡，然能以法繩其驕放，營壘守戰之備，特推精力，議者稱之。
units.en: Cunjin's campaigns produced no legendary feats, yet he disciplined arrogant troops by strict law and was especially tireless in preparing camps and defenses. Commentators spoke well of him.
units.literal: When Cunjin marched out on campaign, though he had no miraculous feats, he could restrain the arrogant and unruly by law, and in preparations for encampment, defense, and battle he was especially noted for exerting energy; commentators praised him.

units.zh: 莊宗舉酒曰：「存進，吾之杜預也。」
units.en: Zhuangzong raised his cup and declared, "Cunjin, you are my Du Yu."
units.literal: Zhuangzong raised his cup and said, "Cunjin, you are my Du Yu."

units.zh: 存進斬伐林樹，版築旬日而就，賊不能寇。
units.en: Cunjin felled timber from the woods and finished the earthworks in ten days, so the rebels could not break through.
units.literal: Cunjin felled forest trees and with tamped earth completed the work in ten days; the rebels could not raid.

units.zh: 詔侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英權知鎮州軍府事。
units.en: An edict named Palace Foot Guards commander Cao Ying acting overseer of Zhenzhou.
units.literal: An edict ordered Cao Ying, commander-in-chief of the Palace Foot Guards, to act as overseer of Zhenzhou military administration.

units.zh: 庚寅，鎮州節度使何福進奏乞朝覲，三奏，允之。
units.en: On gengyin Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin petitioned three times for an audience and was granted permission.
units.literal: On gengyin, He Fujin, military governor of Zhenzhou, memorialized requesting an audience at court; after three memorials permission was granted.

units.zh: 時嗣源遙領鎮州，詰旦，議欲歸藩，上章請罪，安重誨以為不可，語在《明宗紀》中。
units.en: Siyuan still held Zhen at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his post and asked punishment; An Chonghui forbade it—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.
units.literal: At the time Siyuan held Zhenzhou at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his circuit and submitted a memorial asking punishment; An Chonghui held it impossible—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.

units.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞為前軍都虞候。
units.en: Palace Guards cavalry commander Li Shouzhen was made vanguard chief adjutant.
units.literal: Li Shouzhen, commander of the Palace Guards horse army, was made chief adjutant of the vanguard.

units.zh: 開運元年春正月甲戌朔，是夕陣雲掩北斗之魁星。
units.en: On the first day jiaxu of the first month of spring in Kaiyun 1, battle clouds that night veiled the leader star of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, first day jiaxu of the first year of Kaiyun, that night battle clouds covered the leader star of the Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 丁亥，敵騎至黎陽。
units.en: On dinghai enemy cavalry reached Liyang.
units.literal: On dinghai, enemy horsemen reached Liyang.

units.zh: 河東節度使石敬瑭奏，邊軍乏芻糧，其安重榮巡邊兵士欲移振武就糧。
units.en: Shi Jingtang, Hedong military commissioner, reported that border troops lacked fodder and grain and that soldiers under An Chongrong's border patrol wished to move to Zhenwu for provisions.
units.literal: Shi Jingtang, military commissioner of Hedong, memorialized that the border armies lacked fodder and grain, and that the soldiers of An Chongrong's border-patrol force wished to move to Zhenwu to obtain provisions.

units.zh: 李式、翟光鄴為樞密使，王景崇為宣徽使，餘官各有署置。
units.en: Li Shi and Zhai Guangye were made commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Wang Jingchong palace commissioner, and the remaining posts were each filled.
units.literal: Li Shi and Zhai Guangye were made commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Wang Jingchong was made palace commissioner, and the remaining offices were each filled.

units.zh: 會契丹主死，其汴州節度使蕭翰謀歸北地，慮中原無主，軍民大亂，則己亦不得按轡徐歸矣；
units.en: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north. He feared that with no ruler in the Central Plains and army and people in chaos, he himself could not withdraw at leisure;
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north and feared that with no ruler in central China and army and people in great disorder, he himself would be unable to rein in his horse and withdraw at leisure;

units.zh: 丙午，壽州劉仁贍上表乞降，帝遣閣門使張保績入城慰撫。
units.en: On bingwu, Liu Renzan of Shouzhou petitioned to surrender; the Emperor sent Zhang Baoji of the Gate Department into the city to reassure him.
units.literal: On the day bingwu, Liu Renzan of Shouzhou submitted a memorial begging to surrender; the Emperor sent Zhang Baoji of the Gate Department into the city to comfort and reassure him.

units.zh: 翌日，仁贍復令子崇讓上表請罪。
units.en: The next day Renzan had his son Chongrang submit a further memorial asking to be punished.
units.literal: The next day Renzan again had his son Chongrang submit a memorial requesting punishment.

units.zh: 辛亥，以偽命清淮軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中劉仁贍為特進、檢校太尉、兼中書令、鄆州節度使，以右羽林統軍楊信為壽州節度使。
units.en: On xinhai, Liu Renzan, the Southern Tang-appointed Qinghuai commissioner, was named Special Advancement, acting Grand Marshal, Director of the Secretariat, and Yunzhou commissioner; Yang Xin of the Right Imperial Guard was made Shouzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On the day xinhai, Liu Renzan, military commissioner of Qinghuai Army by usurper appointment, acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Special Advancement, acting Grand Marshal, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and military commissioner of Yunzhou; Yang Xin, commander of the Right Imperial Guard, was made military commissioner of Shouzhou.

units.zh: 戊申，幸壽州城北，劉仁贍與將佐已下及兵士萬餘人出降，帝慰勞久之，恩賜有差。
units.en: On wushen, the Emperor went to the north side of Shouzhou, where Liu Renzan, his staff, and more than ten thousand troops came out to surrender. The Emperor received them with lengthy words of comfort and granted rewards according to rank.
units.literal: On the day wushen, he visited the north of Shouzhou city; Liu Renzan with his officers and more than ten thousand soldiers came out to surrender; the Emperor comforted them at length and bestowed favors in graded amounts.

units.zh: 是日，劉仁贍卒。
units.en: That same day Liu Renzan died.
units.literal: That same day Liu Renzan died.

units.zh: 晉王遣都將李嗣昭、李存審、王建及率師來援同州，戰於城下。
units.en: The Prince of Jin sent Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji to relieve Tongzhou and battle was joined under the walls.
units.literal: The Prince of Jin sent commanders Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji with troops to relieve Tongzhou; they fought below the walls.

units.zh: 先是，繼韜父嗣昭為潞州節度使，戰歿於鎮州城下，晉王欲以嗣昭長子繼儔襲父位。
units.en: His father Li Sizhao had held Luzhou and died at Zhenzhou; the Prince of Jin meant to give the post to eldest son Jichou.
units.literal: Earlier, Jiyao’s father Sizhao was Luzhou military commissioner and fell in battle below Zhenzhou city; the Prince of Jin wished to let Sizhao’s eldest son Jichou succeed his father’s post.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，以供奉官郎公遠充契丹歡好使。
units.en: On gengyin in the ninth month Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was sent as envoy of goodwill to the Khitan.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was made Khitan Goodwill envoy.

units.zh: 龍德三年春三月，晉潞州節度留後李繼韜遣使以城歸順。
units.en: In the third month of Longde 3 Li Jiyao of Luzhou offered the city to Liang.
units.literal: In the third month of spring of Longde 3, Jin Luzhou military retention commissioner Li Jiyao sent envoys offering the city in submission.

units.zh: 十一月戊子朔，以給事中盧撰為右散騎常侍，以尚書兵部郎中兼侍御史、知雜事陳觀為左諫議大夫。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month Lu Zhuan, Secretariat drafter, became Right Regular Attendant-in-Attendance, and Chen Guan, bureau director in the Ministry of War with concurrent investigating censor and charge of miscellaneous matters, became Left Remonstrance Officer.
units.literal: Eleventh month, wuzi new moon: Lu Zhuan, Secretariat drafter, was made Right Regular Attendant-in-Attendance; Chen Guan, bureau director in the Ministry of War of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent investigating censor with charge of miscellaneous matters, was made Left Remonstrance Officer.

units.zh: 觀以祖諱「義」，乞改官，尋授給事中。
units.en: Because his grandfather's taboo name was "Yi," Chen Guan asked to be reassigned and was soon made Secretariat drafter.
units.literal: Guan, because his grandfather's taboo was "Yi," requested a change of office; shortly he was appointed Secretariat drafter.

units.zh: 〈（《遼史》：會同二年正月戊申，晉遣金吾衛大將軍馬從斌、考功郎中劉知新來貢珍幣。
units.en: (The 《History of Liao》 records: In the first month of the second year of Huitong, on the wushen day, Jin sent Ma Congbin, great general of the Golden Wu Guard, and Liu Zhixin, director of the Bureau of Merit, to present precious tribute.
units.literal: (The 《History of Liao》 records: In the first month of the second year of Huitong, on the wushen day, Jin sent Ma Congbin, Great General of the Golden Wu Guard, and Liu Zhixin, Director of the Bureau of Merit, to present precious goods in tribute.
